items.title: Paquito D'Rivera — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And what happened to that first marriage? Maria, a very fine harpist... So, you were married for nine months.

ctx.x: And what happened to that first marriage?

Maria, a very fine harpist, fantastic ears, pianist also. But in those days, I was a womanizer, I like women too much. I still like them, but at least I learn how to control myself. [Both laugh] Boy what a problem. So, I—
So, you were married for nine months.
